g.text: Every leadership type brings strengths & every leader can grow.
You help turn ideas into action. You bring energy and
determination when a group needs momentum,
helping people take practical next steps.
You may be ready to act quickly. Taking time
to understand the situation can strengthen
You focus on what can happen now.
Exploring more than one path can reveal
You bring energy to ideas and help people
Before moving forward, ask one question that
helps you better understand the situation
